description: Declare the non-2xx statuses Discord actually returns on operations the spec types only as `4XX`. Discord's OpenAPI gives every operation a `429` and a `4XX` catch-all, so the converter lifts nothing per status and callers could not `catchTag` a `NotFound`. Each entry below was observed live on 2026-10-02 with a bot token: GET /guilds/{guild_id} → 404 `{ "message": "Unknown Guild", "code": 10004 }` for both a nonexistent id and a guild the bot is not a member of; GET /channels/{channel_id} → 404 `{ "message": "Unknown Channel", "code": 10003 }`. Add an operation here only with the request and response written down; a status guessed from the docs gives callers a type they trust for a failure that may never happen.
